about.biography:
sanae elouahdani, I am a passionate Professor specializing in Electronics, Automation, and Embedded Systems.

With over a decade of experience in academia and applied research, my focus lies in bridging the gap between theoretical electronics and practical, real-world embedded applications.

My mission is to educate the next generation of engineers through hands-on learning, interactive labs, and comprehensive digital tools, while contributing to state-of-the-art research in FPGA-based control systems.

teaching.title: Instrumentation & Control
